notes: Both תּוֹעֵבָה constructs are the predicates of their verbless clauses and take the construction-supplied copula with the indefinite article they license (rule 20); each rectum takes the recast relational *to* with the *the* the ASV writes before its own word (rule 19).

אִישׁ עָוֶל is rendered attributively (rule 28), while יְשַׁר־דָּרֶךְ keeps the *of*-less recasting *he that is upright in the way*, the substantival adjective taking the supplied *he that is* (rules 46, 20).
